name: password-input
title: Password Input
description: A password field that requires a strong password, with a strength meter, a live requirement checklist, and a show/hide toggle.

useCases: Requiring a strong password in sign-up, password reset, and change-password forms, with live feedback on each requirement.
limitations: Strength comes only from synchronous rules; there is no entropy estimate, breached-password lookup, or confirmation field. Every rule must pass for the field to be valid.
requirements: React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, Motion, Phosphor icons, and the shadcn input and label components. Supply a label. Controlled usage requires updating value in onValueChange. Reduced motion removes the shake and transitions.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/components/password-input.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
